category_edits.rationale: Reduce the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.8 to 0.65 across all four datasets to test stronger representation regularization. Width, tying, frequency features, loss and optimizer remain fixed. The generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training and inference consistency.

change_summary: Lower the normalized tied embedding radius multiplier to 0.65 for each category’s single BERT4Rec model.
